GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_FLOW.title: Flow
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_FLOW.description: Triggers its extra effect if this card's color differs entirely from the last card played.
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_AMPLIFY.title: Kick n
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_AMPLIFY.description: Discard up to n cards; for each card discarded, play this card once more.
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_MIRACLE.title: Miracle
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_MIRACLE.description: Triggers its extra effect if this card was not auto drawn at the start of this turn.
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_PHANTOM.title: Phantom n
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_PHANTOM.description:
After playing, add n temporary copies to your hand with -1 Energy cost, no Phantom or Rebound, and Exhaust. 
Defaults to 1 if no number is specified.
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_STORM.title: Storm
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_STORM.description: Storm (condition): After playing, if your current [gold]Energy[/gold]/[gold]Stars[/gold] meet the condition shown on the card, play it once more.
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_ECHO.title: Rebound
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_ECHO.description: Return this card to your hand after playing it.
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_TEMPORARY.title: Temporary
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_TEMPORARY.description: A card temporarily added during combat. Generated copies count even if a card with the same name is in your permanent deck.
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_HOARD.title: Hoard
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_HOARD.description: At end of turn, retain up to n cards, then lose stacks equal to the number retained.
EXHAUST.title: Exhaust
EXHAUST.description: Removed from your deck until the end of combat.
INNATE.title: Innate
INNATE.description: Start each combat with this card in your hand.
ETHEREAL.title: Ethereal
ETHEREAL.description: If this card is in your hand at the end of your turn, it is exhausted.
RETAIN.title: Retain
RETAIN.description: This card stays in your hand at the end of your turn.
UNPLAYABLE.title: Unplayable
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_BONUS.title: Bonus n
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_BONUS.description: When drawn, draw n extra cards.
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_VIRTUE.title: Virtue
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_VIRTUE.description: When played, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_LIMITED.title: Limited
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_LIMITED.description: Each turn you can only play 1 card of each Limited name.
GAOSHOU_KEYWORD_LIMITED.dialogue: I can only play 1 card of each Limited name each turn.
